admission.justification: Send transport and settlement jointly avoid accidental resend to successful recipients and avoid discarding failed-target context, with partial and network-failure tests.

applicability: Browser application of terminal answers for one captured Send snapshot.
conditions: Delivered and held answers both count as sent for settlement, but each outcome remains visibly distinct.
If no target refused, only that Send’s pick IDs are removed and text clears only when unchanged; later picks and edited text remain.
If any target refused, picks and text remain and the next target set contains only refused targets, preventing resend to delivered/held targets.
Network or malformed-answer failure is surfaced as refusal and retains the collection.
exclusions: Held is not displayed as delivered.
Later asynchronous held loss is recorded by the sent log, not automatically restored into the browser collection.
